name: How much does a typical kitchen remodel cost in Los Angeles County, and what’s a realistic budget per square foot?

mainEntity.name: How much does a typical kitchen remodel cost in Los Angeles County, and what’s a realistic budget per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Most mid-range kitchen remodels in Los Angeles County fall roughly between $50,000–$120,000+, or about $300–$700 per square foot, depending on finishes, layout changes, and structural or electrical work. High-end, custom projects can go well beyond that range. 
Context: Costs are driven by local labor rates, material choices, and how much you move plumbing, walls, or gas lines. Removing walls, adding beams, or upgrading old wiring/ plumbing will push the budget higher than a simple cosmetic update. 
Key factors:
- Size of the kitchen and whether you’re reconfiguring the layout
- Level of finishes (stock vs semi-custom vs custom cabinets, appliance brands, countertops)
- Needed upgrades to electrical panel, plumbing, and ventilation
- Permits, inspections, and any structural engineering
Practical guidance: Start by defining your must-haves vs nice-to-haves, then get 2–3 detailed written bids based on the same scope so you can compare apples to apples. Ask each contractor for a line-item budget breakdown and an allowance list for finishes. Soft positioning: A seasoned remodeling contractor can help you align scope and selections with a realistic LA-area budget before you commit.
